items.name: dsh-pocket
items.desc: Remote phone access to the DSH Web UI: scan a QR code for LAN or public (cloudflared tunnel) access with real-time sync, a mobile-adaptive layout, and a settings tab.

items.name: dsh-lark-bot
items.desc: Feishu/Lark bridge for DeepSeek Harness: scan-to-connect PersonalAgent binding, streaming cards, git-worktree project workspaces, parallel per-scope tasks, multi-role agents, cross-session notify, in-chat model/key management, and a safety-net guardian that still answers in Feishu after dsh crashes.

items.name: dsh-notifier
items.desc: DSH notification & remote-control plane: one `notify()` API across 28 outbound channels, six inbound control channels, phone approvals/questions/task control, a Native DSH Notify & Control UI, live outbound hot-apply, multi-agent routing, and zero runtime dependencies.

items.name: deepseek-harness-acp
items.desc: ACP profile plugin and standalone stdio server for using the full DSH agent from Zed and other ACP clients while sharing DSH credentials and sessions.

items.name: dsh-im
items.desc: Connect IM bots to DeepSeek Harness via QR codes or bot credentials (9 channels: Feishu, WeChat, DingTalk, WeCom, QQ, Slack, Telegram, Discord, and WhatsApp).

items.name: dsh-email
items.desc: IMAP/SMTP email tools (list/read/search/send/folders/attachment/health/watch/mark/reply) with since/until date-range filters, email_mark for read/unread/star/move, email_reply for reply/reply-all/forward with threading headers, QQ/163/126/Sina/Aliyun/Gmail/Outlook/iCloud presets, multi-account support, a send-approval gate, a web settings page and a whale-girl new-mail popup driven by the incremental email_watch checker. Outlook OAuth2 device-code login works out of the box through a built-in community client, and an account can still supply its own clientId instead. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.

items.name: dsh-telegram-duty
items.desc: Telegram duty gateway: phone-message task loop on a dedicated duty session, global approval forwarding with inline approve/reject buttons, telegram_ask choice questions, duty/local toggle with a web duty banner, zh/en messages, zero idle tokens.

items.name: dsh-im-connect
items.desc: Connects WeChat, WeCom, DingTalk, Feishu, Lark, QQ, and Telegram to a local DeepSeek Harness agent, with each IM chat as a separate workspace channel.

items.name: dsh-msg-hub
items.desc: IM channel bridge: WeChat (ilinkai) / QQ / Feishu with proactive push — wake the channel bot from scheduled tasks and deliver AI replies to your phone.

items.name: dsh-lark
items.desc: Lark/Feishu bot channel for DeepSeek Harness: each chat drives its own agent, and tool approvals, model questions, and plan reviews return as cards answered by a button or a reply. Switch workspace and model from the chat (`/cd`, `/model`, `/new`), and run several bots that keep separate sessions and can hand turns to each other in one group.

items.name: dsh-complete-notify
items.desc: Sound + popup when a task completes: a Web Audio chime, an in-page toast, and a system notification while the page is in the background (browser-only, cross-platform).

items.name: dsh-acp-enhanced
items.desc: Enhanced ACP server for DeepSeek Harness: block & reasoning streaming, usage telemetry, model/effort switching, permission presets, session resume/archive, per-session MCP servers, and Zed file/terminal forwarding.

items.name: dsh-plugin-hub#packages/dsh-notifier
items.desc: Task-event notification center: 6 event kinds (ask / approval / completion / subagent completion / error / turn end), dual channels (browser Notification + host system toast) plus Bark/Webhook push channels (ntfy, Gotify, self-hosted gateways); quiet hours with urgent exceptions, approval-timeout re-reminders, completion-storm aggregation, and notification text redaction.

items.name: dsh-web-launcher
items.desc: One-click launcher for the Web UI: a double-click Start-DSH-Web.cmd on the Windows desktop that boots dsh web and auto-opens the browser (polling until ready), plus a web_launcher model tool (install / open / status).

items.name: dsh-hooks
items.desc: Config-driven lifecycle hooks: event→command declarations in cordis.patch.yml, with Feishu card notifications and a QR scan-to-create bot setup.

items.name: dsh-obvious-grid
items.desc: Ambient fullscreen status grid for DeepSeek Harness sessions with token/rate graphs, plus ntfy push and alarm notifications when a turn ends, errors, or waits for approval.

items.name: dsh-update-notifier
items.desc: Checks npm hourly for newer versions of the installed plugins and asks which ones to upgrade.

items.name: dsh-slack
items.desc: Two-way Slack messaging (notify/channels/inbox/reply/health) over Socket Mode, no public callback needed.

items.name: dsh-ticktick
items.desc: Two-way TickTick/Dida365 (滴答清单) task sync via the official OAuth Open API: pull tasks across lists, create/update/complete/delete tasks, and one-shot title-deduped sync, with a web settings panel.

items.name: dsh-imessage
items.desc: Two-way iMessage channel for DeepSeek Harness over Photon: sender allowlisting, session commands, in-chat approvals and questions, and a Settings page for device authorization and hosted-line setup.

items.name: dsh-niao-message
items.desc: macOS system notifications for DeepSeek Harness: aborted, max-tokens, blocked, interrupted and error events, pending questions and approvals, and completion or subagent-end via terminal-notifier; clicking a banner opens a configured app and returning to the page auto-dismisses them.

items.name: dsh-peak-cost-mode
items.desc: Auto-switches the agent to ultra-compressed caveman-style output during DeepSeek peak-pricing hours (Beijing 09:00–12:00 / 14:00–18:00, price x2) and shows a status badge plus transition toasts.

items.name: dsh-im-hub
items.desc: Multi-platform IM gateway for DSH: Feishu (Lark) WebSocket long connection (no public URL), WeCom AES-encrypted callbacks, and Telegram long polling — per-chat agent sessions, whitelist access, and a visual settings card in the web GUI.

items.name: dsh-dingtalk
items.desc: DingTalk group-robot notifications (notify/text/health; webhook + HMAC signing, zero runtime dependencies).

items.name: dsh-dingtalk-channel
items.desc: DingTalk IM channel via Stream-mode WebSocket: each chat drives its own tooled agent; replies stream back as messages, no public callback URL needed.

items.name: dsh-chatgpt-bridge
items.desc: MCP bridge that lets ChatGPT Web create, view, continue, and supervise DeepSeek Harness agent sessions and goals while preserving DSH's native approval, sandbox, and workspace security model.

items.name: dsh-sound-lab
items.desc: Event sounds for DSH: plays a chosen sound on session end, options popup, permission request and stop, with AI-generated character voice lines and a manageable sound library.

items.name: dsh-notify-skill
items.desc: Email reminders from your DSH agent when you're away: fires at goal completion, blockage, before asking the user a decision, and at long-task milestones via a bundled zero-dependency Node SMTP sender.

items.name: dsh-mobile-remote
items.desc: Drive your dsh agent from WeChat over the iLink gateway: two-way encrypted media transfer (auto-decrypt inbox + /send), proactive weixin_send tool, completion notifications, multi-session switching, and a health panel with file logging.

items.name: dsh-feishu-chat
items.desc: Two-way Feishu (Lark) chat bridge for DeepSeek Harness over the official WebSocket long connection: messages route to the bound workspace's latest session and replies return automatically; bot credentials and workspace routing are configurable from the settings page.

items.name: openpets#dsh
items.desc: Bridges DeepSeek Harness lifecycle status, errors, and approval requests to a locally running OpenPets desktop companion.

items.name: dsh-notification
items.desc: Desktop notifications for turn completions, with per-outcome controls and keyword rules.

items.name: dsh-open-in-vscode
items.desc: Open DSH workspace directories in VS Code directly from the web GUI.

items.name: dsh-suite#plugin-notify
items.desc: IM webhook and local notifications on turn completion, errors, or approval (Feishu/WeCom/DingTalk/Slack/Discord/custom).

items.name: dsh-lark-link
items.desc: High-reliability Feishu/Lark bridge for DeepSeek Harness: QR one-click auth, card-based commands and intent-confirmation cards, at-least-once zero-loss outbox, media in/out, /doctor session-log ZIP, and a reusable DSH Web GUI that lands sessions in the right workspace.

items.name: dsh-web-ui-notify
items.desc: Desktop notification reminders.

items.name: dsh-session-notification
items.desc: Notifications for four session states, with browser alerts and prompts.

items.name: dsh-feishu
items.desc: Feishu (Lark) UI for DeepSeek Harness — a panel-driven control console: every slash command is a button on the ⚙️ control-panel card, in-card approvals and questions, live streaming cards, and one-QR app setup.

items.name: dsh-acp-for-bitfun
items.desc: ACP bridge between BitFun and DSH.

items.name: dsh-im-bridge
items.desc: Two-way WeChat (iLink) bridge: turn-end and approval-request push, in-chat approve/reject and message injection, persistent dedup and convergent long-reply chunking; channel layer extensible to other IMs.

items.name: dsh-telegram-channel
items.desc: Telegram mobile remote that attaches the phone to a live DeepSeek Harness Web session: workspace-then-session picker (/sessions), /last for the previous Q/A, /model switch, and native Rich Message replies.

items.name: dsh-lark-bridge
items.desc: Bidirectional Lark/Feishu controller for DeepSeek Harness with project and session routing, interactive cards, approvals, attachments, and task controls.

items.name: dsh-feishu
items.desc: Connect a Feishu bot to DeepSeek Harness by scanning a QR code.

items.name: dsh-lark-meeting-notifier
items.desc: Feishu meeting reminder: a dsh-plugin which has only side effect: reminding you, mid-flow with AI, that you "have to go meet carbon-based lifeforms".

items.name: dsh-chatnode-wechat
items.desc: Chat with, monitor, and approve your DSH agents from WeChat via the iLink gateway: text both ways, session targeting, digest heartbeats, and numbered approval prompts.

items.name: telegram
items.desc: Bridge to the Telegram Bot API: long polling, per-chat sessions, HTML formatting.

items.name: tuning-engines-cli#tuningengines-dsh-plugin
items.desc: Exports metadata-only DSH turn, model, tool, approval, retry, and error events to Tuning Engines for governed traces, policy evaluation, cost analysis, and Work Session review, with a disk-backed retry queue.

items.name: dsh-feishu-bridge
items.desc: Fail-closed Feishu (Lark) channel bridge: chat with a bot, get dsh agent turns back — with opt-in human-in-the-loop tool approval (Allow/Deny cards before every bash call, fail-closed timeout). Official-Python-SDK-only integration (exact-pinned); deny-by-default allowlist, webhook signature/timestamp/replay verification, per-chat sticky sessions; daily latest-SDK compatibility canary; bilingual docs.

items.name: dsh-island
items.desc: Bridge DSH agent sessions, tool calls, and approvals to the CodeIsland macOS notch panel over a Unix socket, with in-panel allow/deny.

items.name: dsh-lark-bridge

items.name: dsh-messager
items.desc: Monitors session state in the DSH web app and sends desktop, browser, and third-party notifications for interactions, completions, and errors.

items.name: dsh-notify-on-complete
items.desc: Desktop notifications for run completion, model questions, and approval requests with per-platform system sounds, zero runtime dependencies.

items.name: dsh-weixin
items.desc: Connects dsh to Weixin, with arbitrary file sending support.

items.name: dsh-webbridge
items.desc: DSH meets Kimi WebBridge.

items.name: dsh-native-launcher
items.desc: Windows desktop launcher for the DSH Web UI: desktop shortcut, silent start, system tray with open/full-exit (stop service, close app window, quit tray), PWA app window with focus-instead-of-relaunch, install prompt, and task-completion notifications.

items.name: chicheng-push
items.desc: Multi-channel push for DeepSeek Harness: Server酱, PushPlus, Bark, DingTalk, WeCom, Telegram, Feishu, ntfy, custom webhooks and more, configurable from the settings panel and callable by other plugins via the pushNotifier service.

items.name: dsh-messaging#messaging-core
items.desc: Unified messaging gateway for DeepSeek Harness: 27 IM platforms (Telegram, QQ, WeChat, Discord, WhatsApp, Feishu and more) in one plugin, with QR scan-to-authorize, per-platform workspaces, slash commands, and a web setup dialog.

items.name: dsh-wxauto-plugin

items.name: dsh-weixin

items.name: dsh-notifier
items.desc: System-native notifications when a task finishes or needs your confirmation: Windows toast, macOS osascript, and Linux notify-send.

items.name: dsh-email-push-master
items.desc: Email reminders from your DSH agent when you are away, with stable SMTP (no 535 retry loop), connect and idle timeouts, and a --check self-test.

items.name: dsh-wecom

items.name: dsh-weixin

items.name: dsh-task-notify

items.desc: Browser notifications and a beep when a session turn ends, the agent asks a question or approval is pending; clicking the notification jumps to the session; remote trigger endpoint and SSE channel (npm: `dsh-my-notify`).

items.desc: Browser system notification, sounded by the OS notification itself, when a session needs a reply or a run goes idle; no page-focus check, at most one notification per session with a newer one replacing the old, and an idle notice reports how many background tasks are still running.

items.name: dsh-plugin-notify-sounds
items.desc: Plays a soft chime when the agent needs your decision or finishes a task, with system notifications that jump back to the window, repeat reminders, quiet hours, and one-click self-update.

items.name: dsh-notify
items.desc: Native desktop notifications for DSH — approvals, questions, turn completion, session end and errors — with click-to-session, per-event toggles, quiet hours, a privacy switch that keeps message text off the banner, and a Web Audio tone per event type.

items.name: cc-monitor#dsh-cc-monitor
items.desc: Reports DeepSeek Harness session activity to a self-hosted cc-monitor server, which surfaces Claude Code and DSH sessions as color-coded state cards in one web dashboard and pings your browser and Android app when a session needs attention.

items.name: dsh-herald

items.name: dsh-bili-scroll

items.name: dsh-agent-bridge

items.name: dsh-qq-onebot-bridge

items.name: dsh-ping

items.name: dsh-feishucard

items.name: notification

items.name: dsh-hermes-bridge

items.name: dsh-gap-feed

items.name: dsh-messenger-gateway

items.name: dsh-high-fee-alert

items.desc: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Avernet's Bot Collaboration Network over WebSocket V2, with automatic onboarding, isolated agent sessions, tool-call events, and multi-bot routing tools.

items.name: dsh-niulai-sound
items.desc: Approval sound effects from the movie NiuLai: plays 「妈妈」 when user confirmation is requested, interrupts it and plays 「牛来！」 the moment the user approves; native Windows playback, zero external dependencies.

items.name: dsh-imbot
items.desc: Two-way agent bridge for Feishu (Lark) and DingTalk groups: chat with a DeepSeek Harness agent from IM groups via long-connection / Stream Mode — no public port needed. Workspace selection/creation, session switching, archiving (synced with DSH GUI), configurable from the DSH settings page. Feishu uses interactive cards, DingTalk uses text commands.

items.name: dsh-connect#connect
items.desc: Bridges DeepSeek Harness sessions to Feishu/Lark, Telegram and DingTalk: each chat is bound to a resumable DSH session, replies stream back as cards, and a task-end card reports the model, token usage, step count and duration. Question and permission-approval cards are answerable from the chat, and a web settings pane configures the per-channel credentials.

items.name: dsh-telegram-control
items.desc: Telegram remote control for DeepSeek Harness: list conversations with titles and workspaces, resume paused persisted sessions on demand (preset remount), turn-tracked reply relay, first-line reasoning summaries, inline-button approve/reject with outcome edits, and a bot command menu.

items.name: dsh-task-toast
items.desc: Top-right status plate for six session states (complete, error, approval, question, unopenable, subagent), plus an OS notification when you are away.

items.name: dsh-helper
items.desc: Send local files to WeChat from any DSH session by reusing an installed IM plugin, plus cron-scheduled tasks that run in fresh sessions, a workspace activity glow, a header activity indicator, a completion chime, a macOS sidebar vibrancy toggle and a one-click host restart.

items.name: dsh-hybrid-notify
items.desc: Multi-channel notification plugin for DeepSeek Harness: dispatches in-page toasts in the foreground and PWA system notifications (Service Worker) or browser notifications in the background, with per-event toggles for task complete, approval request, question, plan review and errors, persistent notifications, and Web Audio synthesized alert sounds without audio files.

items.name: dsh-im-humanize
items.desc: Humanized fork of @xmanrui/dsh-im (base 4.21.2): humanized message delivery with send-delay and typing two-phase, message_break + streaming coexistence, status reactions, reply quotes, per-bot humanize overrides, and a no_reply reclaim tool — across WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, QQ, Telegram, Slack and WhatsApp channels.

items.name: dsh-notify
items.desc: Native desktop alerts when dsh needs the human — approvals, questions, plan reviews, turn completion, goals, errors and workflow runs — plus a Settings tab for every option, hot-applied.

items.name: dsh-win-notify
items.desc: Real Windows OS toasts for DeepSeek Harness: task-finished, needs-input and needs-approval alerts that persist in Notification Center under DeepSeek branding. Windows-only, zero runtime dependencies.

items.name: dsh-wechat-bridge
items.desc: Two-way WeChat bridge for DeepSeek Harness via the iLink protocol: bind your personal WeChat with a QR scan and chat with a local DSH agent from the chat box (text, images, voice-to-text, files); a web settings panel handles binding/start/stop/status, project-session binding continues the conversation on desktop, proactive wechat_notify pushes include throttling, and the pure-Node daemon runs on Windows/macOS/Linux.

items.name: dsh-bell-notify
items.desc: Web Audio lifecycle cues for DeepSeek Harness: ten configurable events, three low-noise defaults, per-event custom sounds, and no shipped audio assets.

items.name: dsh-dingtalk-notify
items.desc: DingTalk alerts when the agent needs your choice or approval, or finishes a turn; it stays quiet while you are watching the DSH page.

items.name: dsh-ai-question-chime
items.desc: Plays a chime when the AI asks a clarifying question (a `?` / `？` in the message, or an `ask_user_question` tool call). Synthesized via Web Audio API, no audio file, works on every OS.

items.name: dsh-pharos
items.desc: Desktop notifications for DSH: a system toast, a per-kind chime and a tab-title marker when the agent needs you (approval, plan review, question) or a reply finishes in the background; errors, interrupts, usage limits and multi-agent workflow progress alert too. A host half adds SSE delivery, webhook push (WeCom/Feishu/DingTalk/generic), per-turn token/cache/TPS stats, plus three message-format presets (concise, detailed, custom); settings changes auto-save.

items.name: work-personal-secretary#work-personal-secretary
items.desc: Installer and configuration base for a five-plugin DSH assistant suite: probes the Python, WPS and workspace environment, installs the sibling plugins shipped in the same repository, and generates the workspace baseline (instruction layer, memory seed, skills, settings); it also contributes its own settings section and its own host-side setup and check logic.

items.name: dsh-status-chime
items.desc: Speaks a short status line when DSH changes state — turn done, turn error, job done, job failed, goal complete, goal blocked, an approval waiting, or the agent needs your answer — using eight pre-recorded clips in Chinese (default) and English. The audio is played by the host process through ffplay, or through the Windows PowerShell player that ships with the OS, so it does not depend on a Web Audio tab. Windows only.

items.name: dsh-ask-notify
items.desc: Shows a reminder card in the bottom-right corner of the DSH web GUI whenever the agent is waiting for your answer, and adds a desktop notification plus a flashing tab title when you are on another tab or window.

items.name: dsh-weixin-plus
items.desc: WeChat bridge and native Web settings panel with QR scan login, live token health probe, and credential management.

items.name: dsh-message-reminder
items.desc: Raises a Windows desktop notification card when DSH asks you a question, and returns to the asking Session when the card is clicked.

items.name: dsh-you-should-know
items.desc: Surfaces important facts and trade-offs from the current task, with on-demand explanations and optional discussion in the main session.

items.name: dsh-windows-notifications
items.desc: Adds Windows desktop notifications, optional sounds, and DSH-styled in-page notifications for task events.

items.name: my-dsh-plugins#tlnotify
items.desc: Pushes DSH session events to phone IM and lets you reply straight under that message, injecting the text back into the right session. Covers nine event kinds: task completion, execution error, execution blocked, manual abort, token limit reached, abnormal interruption, waiting for your answer, permission request, and waiting for plan confirmation. Channels are QQ single-chat bots and Feishu custom apps, both over WebSocket long connections — no public IP, domain or tunneling needed. Several bots can be configured at once, each subscribing to the sessions it cares about. Approvals and questions arrive with tappable buttons, and replies route home through three layers (button, quoted reply, explicit short-id prefix), falling back to the most recent intervention-needed notification and echoing which session it went to.

items.name: dsh-plugin-noticeme
items.desc: Background notification plugin: desktop notification, with a tab-title fallback, when an approval prompt or an ask-user-question card appears while the page is in a background tab. The host queues approval and question events behind a same-origin endpoint that the client polls every 3 seconds; clicking the notification focuses the page, and the tab title is restored once the page becomes visible.

items.name: agents-plugins#task-complete-notify-for-dsh
items.desc: Sends a desktop notification and chime when a DeepSeek Harness run completes, errors, or waits for approval, with a configurable duration threshold.

items.name: dsh-alert-sound
items.desc: Audio and voice alerts for the dsh web GUI: distinct tones and optional speech for approvals, questions, completions and errors.

items.name: dsh-notice-card
items.desc: Shows a focus-free notice card in the corner when a turn ends or DSH is waiting on an approval or a question.

items.name: dsh-serverchan-watchdog
items.desc: Unofficial host-side ServerChan notifications for DeepSeek Harness: sends mobile alerts through WeChat (ServerChan Turbo) or the ServerChan³ app when approvals, plan reviews, or questions go unanswered beyond a configurable threshold, even with the browser closed.

items.name: dsh-onebot
items.desc: QQ channel for dsh via OneBot 11 (NapCat and friends): reverse or forward WebSocket, DM and group chats, image and voice transcription, t2i text-image cards, merged forwards, and a settings page.

items.name: dsh-harmonyos-hiboard
items.desc: Push DSH task results to the Huawei HarmonyOS assistant-today screen as service cards. After installing, enter the auth code on the plugin settings page: DSH top-left Plugins - dsh-harmonyos-hiboard.

items.name: dsh-session-attention
items.desc: Desktop notification and sound when a turn completes, the agent asks a question, or an approval is requested, each independently toggleable, plus an activity ball that lists live sessions and jumps back to one.

items.name: dsh-notion-oauth-ui
items.desc: Connect Notion from the GUI with OAuth 2.0 + PKCE — official Notion MCP, no integration token.

items.name: dsh-quake-alert
items.desc: Real-time disaster alerts for DeepSeek Harness: Japan earthquakes (P2PQuake) and JMA EEW, tsunami and weather telegrams, global earthquakes (EMSC/USGS) and NOAA tsunamis, mainland China earthquakes (CENC via Wolfx) plus nmc.cn rainstorm and geological-hazard warnings, and US/Canadian NWS and ECCC flood, rainfall and storm-surge warnings — matched against your watch regions and thresholds.

items.name: dsh-desktop-notify
items.desc: Notifies you about 11 configurable DSH agent events (task completion, questions, denied approvals, background subagents/goals/jobs, team tasks, context compaction, triggered schedules, plugin startup and permission changes) as browser Web Notifications through a bundled service worker, falling back to Windows toast or Linux D-Bus, with three silence levels and click-to-open.

items.name: dsh-plugin#dsh-turn-notify
items.desc: Turn event notifications: six event classes (completed, error, interrupted, approval requested, AI question, limit reached) delivered via sound, system notification, in-page banner, webhook, IM and host desktop-notification channels; when several browser windows are open, only one rings.

items.name: dsh-desk-card
items.desc: Windows-only plugin that shows permission requests, waiting questions, task errors and finished turns as native card windows, and can allow a permission request straight from the card.

items.name: dsh-plugin-notifications
items.desc: Adds a Settings card that pops a system notification and optional chime when a conversation turn completes.

items.name: dsh-relay
items.desc: Relay agent approval requests and questions to iMessage / Email / WeChat channels and resolve them by replying with the request number (#N 批准 / 拒绝 / 回答).

items.name: dsh-plugins#serverchan-notify
items.desc: ServerChan3 (Server酱) push notifications when a turn finishes — title, model, project directory, git branch, status and a reply excerpt, with subagent filtering and fire-and-forget delivery.

items.name: dsh-halo
items.desc: One-click publish of DSH conversations as Markdown articles on a Halo CMS blog: confirm in the GUI, type the console password (never stored), and the Q&A record is created through the Halo REST API.

items.name: dsh-notification
items.desc: Desktop and webhook alerts on macOS, Linux and Windows when an agent finishes a turn, errors, or waits for approval — zero-dependency native notifications (osascript / notify-send / PowerShell toast) plus a Slack-compatible webhook, with a configurable minimum turn duration.

items.name: dsh-open-obsidian
items.desc: Opens the Obsidian vault a DSH session is working in, on the first human message — so your sync plugin (Nutstore sync, Obsidian Sync, Obsidian Git, …) starts running and the files the agent edits actually get synced. Skips a vault that is already open, and opens a new window behind the current one instead of stealing focus. Also serializes writers per vault — a second conversation's write is refused before it runs and queued until the holder is done, so a sync client cannot splice two conversations' edits together. Windows only.

items.name: dsh-pet-company
items.desc: Quiet break, water, long-session and late-night reminders delivered by three bundled chibi companions, with cloud bubbles and a light bounce. Works in-page without extra downloads; the optional macOS desktop window uses a separately downloaded Electron helper.

items.name: dsh-deepcanary
items.desc: Evidence-first attention supervision for DeepSeek Harness with C0–C3 policy, deduplicated Inbox alerts, quiet hours, and redacted outcome records.

items.name: dsh-notify-desktop
items.desc: Windows toast notifications for DSH desktop sessions from the host process: turn ends, approvals, questions and a reminder for an unanswered wait, with a selectable sound per situation and imported custom sound files; clicking a toast raises the DSH window.

items.name: dsh-plugin-weixin
items.desc: WeChat (personal WeChat, iLink Bot API) channel: chat with your DSH agent from WeChat, with images, files and voice-note transcription. One WeChat conversation can hold several DSH Sessions (/new, /list, /use) and every option is editable from the settings page. Also published to npm as dsh-plugin-weixin.

items.name: dsh-plugin-notify
items.desc: Adds Windows-native toast notifications and a system tray icon to dsh: alerts when the agent finishes, stops, or errors, with a tray menu to reopen the web page or quit the background process.

items.name: dsh-pocket-console
items.desc: Forwards an unattended DeepSeek Harness run's tool-call approvals and ask_user_question prompts to Feishu cards on your phone. The desktop GUI answers first — a card is only sent after `delaySeconds` (120 by default) with no answer there — and a phone approval grants `allowed-once`, so no authority accumulates on the phone. One outbound WebSocket long connection to Feishu: no public IP, domain, tunnel or relay.

items.name: dsh-task-feedback
items.desc: Live session status on the browser tab favicon with sound notifications for pending input and completed tasks.

items.name: dsh-hiboard-push
items.desc: Huawei HarmonyOS assistant-today (负一屏) task-completion push for DeepSeek Harness: hiboard_push / hiboard_verify tools post Markdown task results to the phone card feed, wire-compatible with the OpenClaw today-task skill, with the authCode managed from the dsh settings panel.

items.name: dsh-turn-music
items.desc: Turn-finished music reminder: when an agent turn ends, play a ringtone or any local audio file (bundled synthesised telephone ring, custom absolute path, or an in-page upload), with a floating chip to pause, resume or dismiss it and loop-until-paused playback; configured in Settings, defaults overridable per deployment.

items.name: dsh-session-attention
items.desc: System notifications, a tab-title dot and a PWA taskbar badge when a reply finishes in the background or a session waits for your approval, plan review or answer, all cleared when you return to the window.

items.name: agent-pet#dsh-agent-pet
items.desc: Reports DeepSeek Harness session state (working, done, error) to the agent-pet macOS desktop overlay and lets it open sessions or start a chat.

items.name: dsh-notify-sound-plus
items.desc: Per-event sound alerts and system notifications for DeepSeek Harness. Four events — turn complete, question, approval and error — each get a switch, a sound picker with instant preview and a system-notification master switch. Nine built-in tones (four per-event defaults plus chime, bell, soft and alert, and a silent option) are synthesized at runtime with the Web Audio API, so no audio files ship with the package. A mode dropdown in General settings offers on, off and a smart mode that defers to the whale widget so the two never double up; the same row has a preview button and a gear opening a full settings dialog with volume, a skip-while-focused option and upload of your own audio up to 2 MB. A speaker button in the composer mutes sound without touching notifications. Works in the web GUI and the Electron desktop app.

items.name: dsh-notice-center
items.desc: Turn the tab icon into a green/amber status light and send browser notifications when a session finishes or awaits your input, with 47 selectable notification sounds.

items.name: dsh-emacs-bridge#dsh-plugin
items.desc: Two-way bridge between GNU Emacs and a running DeepSeek Harness session over loopback HTTP + SSE: submit prompts, stream replies, manage sessions and workspaces, and answer ask-user/approval prompts from Emacs, with a Plugins-page card that installs the Emacs package.

items.name: dsh-guild
items.desc: Discord-like communities in DSH with channels, roles and permissions, message search, and sharing or cloning of DSH sessions.

items.name: dsh-rss-daily
items.desc: Daily news digest from 46 curated RSS sources, edited by the model already configured in dsh, delivered to your IM via webhook, and broadcast in the chat like a regular model reply with zero context cost.

items.name: dsh-feishu-remote
items.desc: Control a DeepSeek Harness agent from Feishu/Lark: send a task by DM, an agent runs it with your configured model and replies in the chat, and a feishu_send tool lets the agent push results. Uses lark-cli's WebSocket connection, so no public webhook is needed, and ships a resident launcher. Note: the plugin does not check who sent a message, so anyone who can DM the bot — by default, members of the Feishu tenant the app belongs to — can drive an agent running with the host's own model credentials and file permissions. Setup is not one `dsh plugin add`: `lark-cli` must be installed and authenticated once, and a Feishu self-built app with the permissions the README lists is required.

items.name: dsh-im-channel
items.desc: Unified IM channel for DeepSeek Harness: Feishu, Telegram, DingTalk, Slack, Discord — persistent conversations, true streaming replies, 40 MCP Feishu tools, slash commands, and an IM-bot status tab in the plugin settings.

items.name: move45clock
items.desc: Move45clock: a health clock for DeepSeek Harness. A 45-minute work timer (5–120 minutes), 12 guided 12–15 minute seated/standing break plans, a visual plan editor, reminder cards scalable to 200%, night reminders at 21:30/22:00/22:30, and optional action-name voice coaching. Window wake is Windows-only.

items.name: dsh-qq-bridge
items.desc: Connects one existing DSH session to QQ through OneBot/NapCat without starting a new session, and uses a fail-closed whitelist plus @-mention, nickname and configurable-probability wake rules to decide which messages reach the model.

items.name: dsh-finreport
items.desc: Scheduled bilingual financial reports for DSH: market quotes, news and macro calendar, with per-target timezones and delivery through eight dsh-im channels.

items.name: dsh-health-reminder
items.desc: Periodic water, stand-up, eye-break and stretch reminders on your own work schedule, with daily and 7/30-day statistics and multiple switchable reminder plans.

items.name: dsh-bulletin#dsh-bulletin-announce
items.desc: An announcement file shared by several agent sessions on one machine. It is a plain text file the agents only append to; before each step a session receives the entries it has not seen yet, a new session catches up on the ones still in effect, and a session whose context was compacted gets them re-sent.

items.name: dsh-focus-notify
items.desc: Focus-aware notifications for DeepSeek Harness: approvals, questions, plan reviews and finished replies appear as one alert only when the conversation window loses focus; background conversations alert at any time and subagent sessions never do.

items.name: dsh-sound-notification
items.desc: Plays a chime when any session's response finishes (rising tone) or a question/approval is asked (falling tone), with a click-to-mute badge.

items.name: dsh-done-sound
items.desc: Play different configurable sounds for five conversation events in the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: normal completion, interrupt, error, approval wait, and auto-retry success; each event has its own audio setting and bundled default, with auto-retry after errors using a configurable wait (10-300s), plus a community sound library. Compatible with DSH 0.1.5-rc.2.

items.name: dsh-audio-cue
items.desc: Audio cues for DeepSeek Harness: a short synthesized sound when an agent needs confirmation, finishes a turn or a background job, or fails, with five sound packs, per-event toggles and volume, and do-not-disturb rules stored in the host settings document.

items.name: dsh-notify
items.desc: Desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness — a web notification while a browser page holds the plugin (turn completion and pending questions), and a native Windows toast from the host for finished turns once the browser is closed.

items.name: dsh-session-notify
items.desc: Notifies you with a browser notification and toast whenever a session turn ends, with 5-language templates and custom presets.

items.name: dsh-overdrive#gateway-core
items.desc: DSH-side remote session driver for the dsh-overdrive chat gateway: exposes sessions, trajectory replay and tap-to-approve to Telegram / Discord / Slack / WhatsApp / Feishu / DingTalk / WeCom bridges. Requires running @dsh-overdrive/gateway alongside.

items.name: dsh-plugin-discord
items.desc: Discord bridge loaded into the same Host as the desktop app or dsh web, with no separate process or profile — chat with sessions in any workspace from DMs or threads, attach to sessions open on the desktop, and answer tool approvals and model questions from whichever side responds first.

items.name: dsh-notify-say
items.desc: Windows desktop notifications for DSH that speak the turn result by default: Windows TTS needs no download, and 13 VOICEVOX voice packs can be installed from the settings page. A completed alert waits until running subagents and background jobs finish; approval, question and error alerts fire immediately. Voice packs are downloaded from GitHub after a terms confirmation.

items.name: dsh-email-notify
items.desc: Email notifications for DSH with an away-mode switch: mails you when a turn ends, a tool waits for approval, or the assistant asks a question. Title and body are editable templates.

items.name: dsh-lark-link
items.desc: Fork of amlyczz/dsh-lark-link (MIT), maintained by Very12345. Per-conversation reasoning-effort controls, multi-app isolation, and streamed task-status cards.

items.name: dsh-plugin-sound-alert
items.desc: Sound alerts for the DSH web UI: a chime when an answer completes and a three-tone prompt when your approval or question is pending, with optional custom WAV stored only in the local browser (pure client-side, zero assets).

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-feishu
items.desc: Talk to DeepSeek Harness from Feishu / Lark. A chat maps to a DSH session, messages become turns and answers are pushed back as cards; questions, permission requests, model switches and conversation switches are interactive cards, and inbound files and images are downloaded into the workspace.

items.name: dsh-no-long-sit
items.desc: Sit-and-water reminder for DeepSeek Harness, with a cat that sits in the corner of the Web GUI. A focus cycle of 30-90 minutes ends in a centered overlay plus a triple chime that gets you up to walk and drink; the later button answers with one real sourced case about prolonged sitting and one about dehydration (built-in library of 17 entries, each with publisher, date and a link to the original); stopping produces a session report with worked time, completed rounds, successful interruptions, snoozes, suggested drinks and a good/mid/bad grade. The cat can be dragged anywhere with its position remembered and loops one animation per state. The timer and the ledger live in the host half, so a page refresh never loses a cycle; it only reminds while a DSH page is open. Cycle lengths, chime volume, cat opacity and grade thresholds are configurable on the plugin settings page.

items.name: dsh-your-turn
items.desc: Turn-handoff reminders in the DSH Web UI with a modal or top banner, six browser-synthesized chimes, configurable auto-dismiss, and a sidebar speaker toggle with an unread session list.

items.name: dsh-complete-chime
items.desc: Plays a short chime when a conversation turn finishes, with three built-in tones or one custom upload, configured in Settings → Plugins.

items.name: dsh-wechat-media
items.desc: Personal WeChat and WeCom (企业微信) bridge: QR pairing, one DSH conversation per chat, two-way text/image/video/document/archive transfer, chat commands (/help, /status, /new, /stop, /friends) answered by the bridge itself without spending a model turn, a switch that restricts the bot to 1:1 chats (group messages are dropped silently and counted), remote approval by replying 1 or 2 in the chat, and a two-way WeCom intelligent robot over its long connection (no public URL needed) that also receives and sends images, files and videos.

items.name: dsh-notify-linux
items.desc: Linux desktop notifications and a chime for DeepSeek Harness, sent by the host process so they still arrive with the browser page closed: turn completion, pending questions, tool approvals and turn errors, delivered through notify-send and paplay with a canberra-gtk-play fallback. A browser half adds an in-page toast, a Web Notification and a synthesized Web Audio chime as fallback; every switch lives in a Settings page or a JSON file.

items.name: dsh-qq-notify
items.desc: Send QQ private-message notifications via a local NapCat bot: qq_send / qq_status / qq_napcat / qq_deploy native tools plus one-click deployment scripts.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-pet-bridge
items.desc: Bridge dsh session status to the cc-pet desktop pet bubble: thinking, tool calls, and completion in real time. Ships on npm as `dsh-pet-bridge`.

items.name: dsh-channels#channels
items.desc: Connects WeChat, QQ, DingTalk, Lark, and Telegram to DeepSeek Harness with unified configuration, private-chat and group access controls, and channel-side Agent chat and session commands.

items.name: dsh-mailbox-notify
items.desc: Emails you when a long turn finishes or errors, when a goal completes or blocks, and when an approval or a question has waited past a timeout; each new notification deletes the previous one from the inbox over IMAP, so the inbox holds at most one.

items.name: dsh-auto-email
items.desc: Daily AI digest by email: fetches ten sources (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Hugging Face, arXiv, Hacker News and others), clusters near-duplicate stories, scores them in code and with an LLM, then emails the top three on a daily schedule with a four-part reading (facts, why it matters, impact, open questions). Adds four conversation tools and a sidebar panel for previewing the digest, sending it now and changing the schedule.

items.name: ui-beep
items.desc: Web Audio agent-heartbeat cues for the DSH web GUI: a low working hum while an agent is busy, ticks on streaming output, and a chime when a session awaits input or work finishes, with per-voice volume, mute toggle, and optional local audio files.

items.name: dsh-notify-xc
items.desc: Browser notification plugin for DeepSeek Harness - system toasts when a task finishes, a run errors, or your input is needed (question / approval / plan review), click to open the session, per-type toggles, and no false 'done' while the main session waits on its subagents.

items.name: dsh-chime
items.desc: Task-completion chime for DeepSeek Harness, playing the original opencode sounds for done, question, plan-review and error events with zero external dependencies.

items.name: dsh-caps-beacon
items.desc: Turns the MacBook keyboard Caps Lock light into an agent status light: on while the agent works, flashing when it waits for your approval or answer, off when idle.

items.name: qqbridge-plus
items.desc: Diving-Fish score lookup for MaimaiDX inside QQ, plus qq-bridge chat extensions. #查分 renders a B50 with song artwork from an OAuth authorisation that any member can use, and works without the bridge running; the extensions cover balance and auto-shutdown, reasoning tier switching by billing peak hours, holiday-table coverage, start/shutdown greetings, and an in-QQ feature toggle.

items.name: dsh-localnotify
items.desc: In-app local notification center for DSH: a sidebar Notifications entry with unread badge, full-screen center with level color coding (info/success/warn/error), time/source filters, sorting, title/content search, read/unread, delete, detail popup with one-click copy, and pagination; written by the notify_add agent tool or the dsh-localnotify CLI (with auto-cleanup retention), page refreshes live, UI follows dsh web language (zh/en).

items.name: dsh-quiet
items.desc: Attention gate for DeepSeek Harness: sorts run events into blocked / terminal / progress and alerts only on the first two, holding everything non-blocking during a /focus block and delivering it when the block ends. Alerts flash the taskbar button only - no toast, no sound, no focus steal. Windows only.

items.name: dsh-task-watcher-plugin
items.desc: Windows-only tray monitor for DeepSeek Harness: deploys and manages the standalone DshTaskWatcher tray app - four-state tray icon (gray=disconnected, green=idle, amber=running, red=attention), a per-task panel with live duration/tps/tokens, and completion & outcome notifications. Start/stop switch in Settings > Plugins; the watcher is an independent process that survives DSH restarts.

items.name: dsh-notify-yimit
items.desc: Windows system and custom desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness events: task completed, failed, running, awaiting approval, and awaiting answer. Click-to-jump to the session.

items.name: dsh-qqbot-lite
items.desc: Connects QQ Bot private and group chats to DeepSeek Harness Desktop, with per-chat personas, interactive questions, and optional image understanding.

items.name: dsh-ping
items.desc: Sounds a chime and raises a desktop notification when the agent needs you — stage completion, approval requests, awaiting input, task completion, and errors, each with its own tone.

items.name: dsh-notification-sound
items.desc: Plays a Windows system sound when the agent opens a question dialog, when a tool asks for permission, and when a conversation turn ends, plus a fish_beep tool to trigger a sound on demand. Custom audio folders are supported.

items.name: dsh-qqbot
items.desc: QQ official bot channel for DeepSeek Harness (feature-rich fork of tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot): group and private chat with the full agent, sticker library with auto-tagging and AI meme replies, group management (join approval and mute), botplay interactive card events with paginated catalogs, user extension registry (custom slash commands and QQ tools), scheduled wakeups, remote approvals over QQ, and a floating dock web UI.

items.name: dsh-completion-notifier
items.desc: Native macOS completion notifications and user approval alerts with Settings UI for DeepSeek Harness.

items.name: dsh-win-notify
items.desc: Host-layer Windows toast notifications for DeepSeek Harness: agent turn done, error or interruption, subagent done, and background job done, plus alerts when the model asks you a question or a tool approval is pending. The notification logic runs in the DSH host process, so toasts still arrive with the tab or the browser closed; a Win32 foreground probe suppresses them while you are looking at DSH. Windows only.

items.name: dsh-voice
items.desc: Speaks a cue for DeepSeek Harness on Windows: a configurable phrase when an agent turn completes normally, a second phrase when the agent needs you to choose — a question, a plan approval, or a permission request — and a time-of-day greeting when a new conversation starts. A small bubble in the lower-left corner mutes and unmutes every cue with one click, with its own toggle chime. Phrases are synthesized with a Microsoft Edge neural voice (skipping aborted and errored turns, subagent turns, and rounds that a goal is still driving), cached under the DSH home directory and replayed locally, with the desktop SAPI voice as the offline fallback.

items.name: dsh-task-dispatcher
items.desc: TickTick (滴答清单) daily task dispatcher: an interval timer pulls due tasks from a chosen list into a Markdown task file and notifies only when the task set changes (WeChat via ClawBot / flomo / macOS); it can also auto-execute each task in its own headless DSH session under a configurable timeout, optionally gated to DeepSeek's off-peak hours so peak-time work queues to the next off-peak window instead of starting, plus a settings panel for the deferred write-back queue and dispatcher_status / dispatcher_config / dispatcher_run / dispatcher_report tools.

items.name: dsh-approval-voice
items.desc: Plays a chime and speaks a Chinese voice alert when an approval, question, or plan-review popup appears in the DSH web GUI, so you never miss a request.

items.name: dsh-mobile-notify
items.desc: Mobile push when a DSH task goes idle, over 10 channels: ntfy, Bark, DingTalk, WeCom, Feishu, ServerChan, PushPlus, Telegram, Qmsg and generic webhooks. The message carries the session, workspace, elapsed time, turn number and a reply excerpt, and it runs host-side rather than in the browser page.

items.name: dsh-notify
items.desc: Windows toast notifications when a DeepSeek Harness task finishes: the session title, the outcome, and a summary of the final reply, sent once when the agent really stops rather than once per round of a running goal.

items.name: dsh-capybara-notify
items.desc: Capybara secretary for DSH: desktop pet notifications with ding sound, alert inbox API, session-aware alerts (turn done / approval needed / turn blocked), check scripts, and daily high-star plugin recommendations.
